newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier sees C$450 mln rail contract.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier sees C$450 mln rail contract.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Monday that it expected to win a C$450 million contract to supply 252 subway cars to Mexico City's transit commission.

Francine Durocher Monin, spokeswoman for Bombardier's Transportation Group, told Reuters that the transit commission selected the Montreal-based aerospace and transportation equipment manufacturer's proposal on a technical basis.
The commission's next step was to decide on the commercial component of Bombardier's offer, she said. That decision was expected next Monday, she said.
"We are preparing a press release for next Monday for the contract award," Monin said.
The contract would include Bombardier's French partner, GEC-Alsthom NV.
If Bombardier was awarded the contract, it would take about two months to sign the order, Monin said. Bombardier would build the cars at its Sahagun plant north of Mexico City, she said.
